services.name: Popcorn ceiling removal
services.blurb: Tested for asbestos first, then scraped, skimmed and primed into a flat, modern ceiling.

services.name: Texture matching
services.blurb: Orange peel, knockdown, skip trowel or smooth, matched on a sample board before it touches your wall.

services.name: Patch repair
services.blurb: Holes, cracks and old anchor spots patched and checked under a low side light before paint.

services.name: Smooth wall skim coat
services.blurb: A thin coat over the whole wall, the Level 5 finish that hides seams under bright windows.

services.name: Water damage repair
services.blurb: Damp, swollen or moldy board cut out, the cause pointed out, then rebuilt and finished.

services.name: Taping and finishing
services.blurb: New board taped and finished to the level you choose, written on the quote before work starts.

services.name: Soundproofing walls
services.blurb: Insulation, resilient channel or a second layer of board between bedrooms, offices and living rooms.

services.name: Sanding and priming
services.blurb: Dust-controlled sanding, a raking-light check of every wall, then a coat of primer.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our 1972 ranch had popcorn in every room. Noor took a sample on the first visit and waited for the lab result before quoting the scrape. It came back clean and the ceilings are flat now.
reviews.name: Kelsey R.

reviews.text: The quote said Level 4 for the bedrooms and Level 5 for the living room with the big west window. At sunset I can finally look at that wall without seeing every seam.
reviews.name: Jonah P.

reviews.text: Knockdown texture that four people told me could not be matched. They brought three sample boards and we picked the second one. I honestly forget where the patch was.
reviews.name: Mira L.

reviews.text: Black spots behind the washer turned out to be a slow drain leak. They cut out the board, showed me the drain line, and told me to call a plumber before they closed it up. Fair and clear.
reviews.name: Ben T.

reviews.text: Home office shares a wall with the kid's room. Second layer of board plus insulation in the cavity. Video calls are quiet now, mostly.
reviews.name: Sasha V.

reviews.text: I liked that they shined a work light along the wall at the end and walked me through it. Two small spots got touched up before they left.
reviews.name: Eli G.

proof.guarantee: Walk the finished wall with us under a work light; anything you point out is fixed before we leave.
